message.content: The research selects Sylvia Pfeiffer Williams for the District 4 Governing Board Member / School Director seat. In questionnaire responses, Williams described BDS aimed at changing Israeli government policies as a good nonviolent option while committing to oppose anti-Jewish discrimination, and she expressed regret that an OEA resolution condemning Israel's disproportionate response omitted acknowledgment of Israeli victims and hostages, saying she would respect Jewish voices in future discussions. On antisemitism-education policy, she supported classroom criticism of Israeli policies while preserving multiple perspectives, answering with a dialogue approach rather than an explicit AB 715 implementation pledge. By contrast, Kathryn Camp stated she would review policies, materials, training, and corrective processes for full AB 715/SB 48 compliance and report implementation outcomes, and described supporting Israel's peaceful existence. Camp also held an endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club. Mike Hutchinson, as OUSD board president, refused to let hundreds of Gaza ceasefire protesters speak and abruptly shut down a board meeting, and later backed the blocking of a Gaza ceasefire resolution from the agenda despite four of seven members supporting it.
